description: $0.02 per page. Use to index or price a pons curve: Robinhood Chain reserves rebuilt to the wei, per buy, sell and buyback in block order: amounts, fee, taxes, price, next_cursor. Input: address, since, limit. ETH-paired curves up to 90 min old. Fields: loopholetape://schema/rhc_curve_trades.

address.description: 0x-prefixed 40-hex pons v2 curve OR token address on Robinhood Chain

since.description: optional start, exclusive: next_cursor 'block:log_index' of the previous page, a block number, or unix seconds (values >= 1e9); omitted = from the curve's first trade
